rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “madness” means mental illness or insanity.

example.english: They have madness and need to be hospitalized.
example.traditional: 佢有精神病，要入院治療。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 zing1 san4 beng6 jiu3 jap6 jyun2 zi6 liu4

rows.note: Use this when “madness” means a foolish or rash thing someone does, rather than a mental illness.

example.english: Quitting your job on a whim is madness.
example.traditional: 你一時衝動就辭職，真係傻事嚟㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 si4 cung1 dung6 zau6 ci4 zik1 zan1 hai6 so4 si6 lai4 gaa3
